en: Well, fine. I'll go as I please.{wait}{clear}If you don't like it, feel free to drop me from your list of heroes or whatever they are.{wait}{clear}
Rocus... This is important, so I want a serious answer.{wait}{clear}The other day, someone stole the Church's sacred jewel... Do you know anything about it?{wait}{clear}
...You think I stole it?{wait}{clear}

I don't think that. If you had, you would not have come back to me.{wait}{clear}But the only ones who know where that treasure was kept are you and I.{wait}{clear}We have no leads. I called you here hoping to learn even a little.{wait}{clear}
I do know something... I told a man where the treasure was kept...{wait}{clear}
What do you mean?{wait}{clear}
...A bet.{wait}{clear}I lost a bet, and told that man where the treasure was hidden.{wait}{clear}
You staked the location of the sacred jewel on a wager? Rocus!{wait}{clear}How could you! You...{wait}{clear}
And what was that man's name?{wait}{clear}
His real name is Clarence... Langerack, I believe.{wait}{clear}His friends called him by his nickname, Viper.{wait}{clear}
We must find that man as soon as possible...{wait}{clear}But Rocus... I am truly disappointed in you...{wait}{clear}
To barter away your duty as Pope for money...{wait}{clear}It seems I was a fool to expect any judgment from you...{wait}{clear}
I...{wait}{clear}
I am tired of your excuses... Why was the holy power given to a man like you...?{wait}{clear}
I... I never wanted to be here!{wait}{clear}Who would ever wish for this power?!{wait}{clear}You're the ones who decided on your own to make me Pope!{wait}{clear}
Rocus...{wait}{clear}Never return to the Holy City again.{wait}{clear}That is an order.{wait}{clear}
You don't have to tell me! I have no intention of ever coming back!{wait}{clear}
The sacred jewel?{n}
Rocus... What is this sacred jewel?{wait}{clear}

...It's the Demon Stone that was guarded in this church.{wait}{clear}Proof that our founder, the first Pope Elias, saved the world...{wait}{clear}It was guarded so that it would never fall into human hands again.{wait}{clear}
The Demon Stone of Delphinia... The egg of the Heavenly Dragon, the root of the chaos a thousand years ago.{wait}{clear}
Yes... It's called that too...{wait}{clear}

But... I didn't reveal where the treasure was of my own free will...{wait}{clear}The moment I lost at cards... I couldn't defy his words.{wait}{clear}As if I'd fallen under a powerful spell...{wait}{clear}
Damn it...{wait}{clear}I'll make him pay for this, I swear. That Viper...{wait}{clear}
Rocus, please calm down...{wait}{clear}

...I'm fine. I never wanted to come back here in the first place...{wait}{clear}Viper... I owe him one now...{wait}{clear}I don't care if I'm driven out of the Holy City... but I won't let it end with him making a fool of me...{wait}{clear}
When I lost to him at cards, he made me talk. As if I were under a spell.{wait}{clear}I'll find him... I'll find Viper.{wait}{clear}
Viper and the Empire... What are they after...?{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄. If Viper shows up again, I want you to tell me.{wait}{clear}I want to settle this... with my own hands.{wait}{clear}
Honestly, you really work a man to the bone. Here, there, everywhere. I couldn't be any busier.{wait}{clear}
But when something happens, it can't be helped...{wait}{clear}
You have other heroes, don't you? It doesn't have to be just me...{wait}{clear}
The other heroes don't complain the way you do, Rocus...{wait}{clear}
What's that?{wait}{clear}
Huh? Rocus, where are you going? Please wait!{wait}{clear}
Eh? Rocus, where are you going? Please wait!{wait}{clear}
I'm so glad. That child was saved thanks to you, Rocus.{wait}{clear}And we got her home safely...{wait}{clear}Besides, you acted so quickly. I was very impressed.{wait}{clear}
Was I...?{wait}{clear}You have the power to save that child too, don't you? You were slow... to notice...{wait}{clear}
Um... may I ask you something?{wait}{clear}
What was that power you used back then, Rocus? I had heard you had a mysterious power, but...{wait}{clear}
That... That power is what they call the mark of the Pope. I have no need for such a thing...{wait}{clear}
Man's Voice
You! What're you muttering about by yourself?! You wrecked our plan, and now you're gonna pay for it!{wait}{clear}
Rocus...?{wait}{clear}
What an awful story... No money, so they kidnap a child...{wait}{clear}Do they think money gotten that way will do anything for them?{wait}{clear}
Not everyone is like that...{n}
You're kind...{n}
I understand what you're trying to say. But I believe not everyone is like them.{wait}{clear}
Hmph... I envy how carefree you are...{wait}{clear}The world is the way it is because people like them are everywhere, isn't it?{wait}{clear}
You're truly very kind at heart, aren't you?{wait}{clear}That child and her parents are grateful to you. I'm sure your feelings reached them, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
Hmph... Don't say strange things with such a serious face...{wait}{clear}
Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄! I've no intention of staying in a place like this forever.{wait}{clear}I refuse to sleep outdoors! Let's hurry up and go so I can get some sleep.{wait}{clear}
Y-Yes! Ah, please wait, Rocus...!{wait}{clear}
Ow...{wait}{clear}
Rocus, are you all right?{wait}{clear}

Heh, how stupid... I play the dashing rescuer, and then I take their revenge for it...{wait}{clear}Even so... kidnapping a helpless child to squeeze out money...{wait}{clear}Do they think money gotten that way will do anything for them?{wait}{clear}
Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄! I've no intention of staying in a place like this forever.{wait}{clear}I refuse to sleep outdoors. Let's hurry up and go so I can get some sleep.{wait}{clear}
The city...{wait}{clear}
The Holy City... the symbol of our holy nation... is burning...{wait}{clear}
Speak to him{n}
Don't{n}
...I...{wait}{clear}......{wait}{clear}
...{wait}{clear}No, let's leave him be...{wait}{clear}
The Vice Pope and the archbishops are said to be at the church in Ilyus, in Valese...{wait}{clear}I'm going there too...{wait}{clear}
They were safe?{n}
I understand. Please be careful...{wait}{clear}
Yes... Sorry.{wait}{clear}
They were safe?{wait}{clear}
Yes, it seems so...{wait}{clear}......{wait}{clear}
Zeam
Excuse me, Vice Pope.{wait}{clear}Before you speak, there is one thing I wish to confirm.{wait}{clear}
Confirm?{wait}{clear}

Yes... It concerns the stolen treasure.{wait}{clear}It's said that the Demon Stone is behind the Empire's growing military might.{wait}{clear}It is already clear that the Empire, using the Crimson Moon King's name, means to revive the legend...{wait}{clear}
Azuria

In other words... wasn't it the theft of the treasure that brought this about?{wait}{clear}Our Holy City has been lost... the Holy City we guarded for a thousand years...{wait}{clear}And doesn't the responsibility lie with you, Vice Pope, and with Rocus, the candidate for Pope?{wait}{clear}
How was the sacred jewel, our greatest secret, stolen by the enemy? We would like you to explain that first.{wait}{clear}

I have not confirmed... that the Demon Stone actually went to the Empire.{wait}{clear}But I have word that mages are working in the shadows of the Empire.{wait}{clear}And... I do not intend to make excuses for the Demon Stone's theft.{wait}{clear}The treasure was taken and has not come back, and the Holy City has fallen.{wait}{clear}However... I cannot quarrel with you over this now, you who are cardinals as well.{wait}{clear}We must think of a way to stand against the Empire's power as it is now.{wait}{clear}If we do not unite now, our Church will surely be destroyed before the Empire.{wait}{clear}
Ryan

We understand that, Vice Pope...{wait}{clear}Every bishop and priest here knows of your long service to the Church, and your leadership.{wait}{clear}No one here would seek to impeach you.{wait}{clear}We only wish to confirm... whether that Rocus did, in fact, take the Demon Stone... the treasure.{wait}{clear}

No. Rocus has nothing to do with the treasure. I met with him and confirmed it...{wait}{clear}He is still young. His past conduct, and his present conduct, can hardly be called admirable, but...{wait}{clear}He is still the one and only candidate to be the next Pope of this Church.{wait}{clear}He has done nothing to betray the Church, nor will he ever.{wait}{clear}I, as his guardian, vouch for that.{wait}{clear}
...Then it was the power of the enemy's mages...{wait}{clear}
What are we to do...? I heard there were monsters shaped like devils among the imperial army in the western war...{wait}{clear}...Is there no way to make peace?{wait}{clear}
There can be no peace with the Empire, much less with those who wish for the Crimson Moon King's return...{wait}{clear}
But... then are we to simply wait to be destroyed?{wait}{clear}
Now is the time to endure. Much about the Empire's power is still a mystery.{wait}{clear}They show no sign yet of invading this land. Let us watch the Empire's situation for a while.{wait}{clear}
...He would never betray the Church, was it?{wait}{clear}Easy to say... when he knows what a sorry mess I am...{wait}{clear}
The Vice Pope believes in you{n}
That's enough...{n}
Rocus... The Vice Pope believes in you, you know.{wait}{clear}

Hmph, no, he doesn't... He said that only because nothing else would settle things.{wait}{clear}If he announced now that the treasure was stolen because of me, the Church would collapse.{wait}{clear}There would be no Pope left on this earth... That's how sacred they consider my power...{wait}{clear}It's utterly ridiculous... A farce, all of it.{wait}{clear}
Rocus, that's enough. What good does it do for you to be like this?{wait}{clear}When so many people... are suffering and trying to fight...{wait}{clear}
